1: """Unit tests for the schema agnostic ingest probe.
2: 
3: The Saturday dataset has an unknown schema, so the probe is the only piece
4: of ingest that must work on every shape. These tests pin the axes the
5: adapter cannot assume:
6: 
7: * encoding: utf-8, utf-8 with BOM, latin-1, and a multi byte character
8:   split by the detection prefix cut;
9: * delimiter: comma, semicolon, and tab;
10: * date order: DD/MM proved by a first position value above 12, MM/DD proved
11:   by a second position value above 12, and the ambiguous case;
12: * sign convention: single signed amount, separate debit/credit columns,
13:   positive amount with a type column (by name and by value), and no signal;
14: * friendly failure: binary garbage, prose without delimiters, zero byte
15:   files, comment only files, header only files, and missing files all exit
16:   1 through fail() with one stderr line and never a traceback.
17: 
18:     uv run pytest scripts/ingest/test_probe.py
19: """

25: from typing import Callable

36: def write_text(
37:     tmp_path: Path, name: str, text: str, encoding: str = "utf-8"

46:     action: Callable[[], object], capsys: pytest.CaptureFixture[str], needle: str
47: ) -> None:
48:     """Assert fail(): exit code 1, one error line on stderr, no traceback."""
49:     with pytest.raises(SystemExit) as excinfo:
50:         action()
51:     assert excinfo.value.code == 1
52:     captured = capsys.readouterr()
53:     assert "Traceback" not in captured.err

75:     ],

78:     """Currency noise parses; identifiers, dates, and prose stay None."""
79:     got = probe_schema.parse_money(text)

99: def test_detect_encoding_strips_a_utf8_bom() -> None:
100:     """A BOM selects utf-8-sig so the first header survives intact."""
101:     raw = "date,amount\n2025-12-05,-4.50\n".encode("utf-8-sig")
102:     assert raw.startswith(codecs.BOM_UTF8)
103:     assert probe_schema.detect_encoding(raw, truncated=False) == "utf-8-sig"

111: def test_detect_encoding_falls_back_to_latin1() -> None:
112:     """A whole file that does not decode as UTF-8 becomes latin-1."""
113:     raw = "Café au lait".encode("latin-1")
114:     assert probe_schema.detect_encoding(raw, truncated=False) == "latin-1"
115:     # Far from the prefix cut, a latin-1 byte in a long file stays latin-1.
116:     far = b"a" * 100 + "\xe9".encode("latin-1") + b"b" * 100
117:     assert probe_schema.detect_encoding(far, truncated=True) == "latin-1"

121:     """A UTF-8 sequence split by the prefix cut still reports utf-8."""
122:     whole = "é" * 10
123:     cut = whole.encode("utf-8")[:-1]
124:     assert probe_schema.detect_encoding(cut, truncated=True) == "utf-8"
125:     # The same bytes as a complete file are invalid UTF-8, so latin-1 wins.
126:     assert probe_schema.detect_encoding(cut, truncated=False) == "latin-1"

208: def test_date_verdict_dd_mm_when_a_first_position_value_exceeds_12() -> None:

2: 
3: Last updated: Nov 05 2026
4: 
5: ## Nov 05 2026 - Phase 0: Zero Byte CSV Fix Re-run
6: 
7: Re-run of every suite after the zero byte CSV fix landed: both
8: `scripts/build_world.py` and `scripts.build_players.py` now route

18: |-------|---------|---------|-------|

27:

29: 
30: An empty CSV written inside the repository root and passed to
31: `uv run python -m scripts.build_world --input <csv> --out-dir <dir>`
32: exits with code 1 and prints exactly one line on stderr:
33: 
34: `error: <path>: No columns to parse (empty or comment-only CSV)`
35: 
36: No traceback, no pandas frames, and no output directory was created
37: (the failure happens before any write). The identical run through
38: `scripts.build_players.py` behaves the same: exit 1, friendly one
39: liner, zero traceback markers.

42: 
43: - Pytest: 41 tests, 41 pass, 0 fail. The former product bug
44:   (`test_world_zero_byte_csv_fails_cleanly`) is now green, and the
45:   build_players mirror test covers the same guard on the second
46:   builder.
47: - Vitest: 106 tests in 13 files, unchanged and all pass.
48: - No open product bugs remain from the Phase 0 pass.
49: 
50: ## Nov 05 2026 - Phase 0: Test Report
51: 
52: Full test pass over the Phase 0 build with the review and security fix
53: cycle in the working tree. 43 new tests were written for the gaps below;
54: every prior test was left untouched and still passes.
55: 
56: ### Suite results
57: 
58: | Suite | Command | Verdict | Notes |
59: |-------|---------|---------|-------|
60: | Web build | `npm run build` | PASS | tsc build config plus vite, 47 modules, 522 ms |
61: | Typecheck | `npm run typecheck` | PASS | strict `tsc --noEmit` including all test files |
62: | Vitest | `npx vitest run` | PASS | 106 tests in 13 files (75 prior plus 31 new) |
63: | Python sync | `uv sync` | PASS | 17 packages resolved, lockfile honored |
64: | Pytest | `uv run pytest` | PASS (41 of 41) | the zero byte CSV failure recorded below was fixed and re-verified in the re-run entry above; the build_players mirror test was added with the fix |
65: | Verify findings | `uv run python -m scripts.analysis.verify_findings` | PASS | 6 of 6 checks, artifacts byte stable after rebuilds |
66: | build_world | `uv run python -m scripts.build_world` | PASS | 46 of 46 provenance checksums, writes world.json and transactions.json |
67: | build_players | `uv run python -m scripts.build_players` | PASS | 1200 of 1200 provenance checksums |
68: 
69: ### Manual sanity pass
70: 
71: `npm run preview` served the built app: index, findings.json, world.json,
72: and transactions.json all returned HTTP 200 with the expected sizes. A
73: temporary end to end test then fetched findings.json over HTTP, parsed it
74: through `parseFindingsSummary`, rendered the five line landing summary
75: with `FindingsSummaryBody` (all F1 to F5 ids, headlines, and the
76: SYNTHETIC DATA badge present), and replayed the auto demo command stream
77: against the live world.json and transactions.json through `reduce` to a
78: `yearComplete` state with the final caption (2 of 2 PASS). That test was
79: deleted after the run; the committed smoke tests keep equivalent
80: coverage.

82: No headless browser is installed in this environment, so a real click
83: through of the PLAY button and the 45 second idle auto demo start was
84: not automated. Those paths rest on `src/app.smoke.test.ts` (SSR shell and
85: play view) and the deterministic DEMO_SCRIPT replay in
86: `src/game/reduce.test.ts`.

89: 
90: | File | Tests | What they cover |
91: |------|-------|-----------------|
92: | `src/game/reduce.edge.test.ts` | 7 | transfer arriving exactly on the closing close completes in the report; a transfer arriving after month 12 stays pending at yearComplete with transfersCompleted 0; loss exactly AT the debt horizon on the closing close (equality loses, horizon plus one cent completes the year); sequential burns against a shrinking fuel budget (accept, reject by identity, accept, reject); unknown selectEntity and rejected engageTransfer still exit auto demo and freeze the clock |
93: | `src/game/orbit.edge.test.ts` | 9 | zero, negative, NaN, and infinite radii rejected by visViva, circularSpeed, orbitalPeriod, meanMotion, hohmannDeltaV, hohmannTransferTime; bad mu; plane change rejects negative or non finite speeds and inclinations; phaseWaitTime rejects non finite mean motions; plane change at 180 degrees costs exactly 2v (pure) and v1 plus v2 (combined); combined 0 degrees between equal speeds costs 0; Hohmann with equal radii costs nothing and takes half the circular period |
94: | `src/data/resolveRows.edge.test.ts` | 5 | well formed but wrong 64 hex digest reports checksumOk false without throwing and still resolves rows; truncated garbage digest reports failure; empty rowIds verify against the empty digest; empty rowIds vouched by a non empty digest fail; rowIds that all miss resolve to an empty broken set with missingIds reported |
95: | `src/data/findings.edge.test.ts` | 10 | rejection matrix over the shipped findings.json: non object roots (null, array, string, number), missing or mistyped meta and syntheticNotice, missing or mistyped sections, missing or mistyped questions, missing or array headline block, NaN, Infinity, and string headline numbers across all seven guarded fields, empty or mistyped headline strings, empty or mixed structuralCategories arrays, NaN and missing values inside section numbers |
96: | `scripts/analysis/test_boundaries.py` | 9 | F1 eligibility boundary at exactly MIN_DEBIT_ROWS (20 eligible, 19 not tested); F1 peak equal to threshold classifies discretionary (strict greater than rule, collaborator stubbed to force float equality); F1 peak one float step above classifies structural; F1 threshold falls back to the white noise band when the control band is lower; F4 category with zero debit rows (Income, credits only) reports all zero deltas and defaults classification to discretionary; F4 category whose rows all sit in the income window has zero aligned deltas while anti aligned still moves them; F4 headline numbers present and integral; aligned_dates_for_mask phase 6 stays and phase 7 moves boundary, phase 25 target arithmetic, NaT next payday never moves, empty mask leaves dates untouched; anti_dates_for_mask moves only masked rows with a next payday |
97: | `scripts/test_build_validation.py` | 3 | header only CSV fails cleanly with "no data rows"; CSV missing account_balance fails cleanly naming the column; zero byte CSV fails cleanly (this test originally exposed the product bug below, now fixed and passing; a fourth build_players zero byte mirror test was added with the fix) |
98: 
99: ### Failure analysis
100: 
101: The single open failure from the original run,
102: `scripts/test_build_validation.py::test_world_zero_byte_csv_fails_cleanly`
103: (a zero byte CSV raising a raw pandas `EmptyDataError` traceback that
104: escaped `fail()`), was fixed in `build_world.py` and the same gap in
105: `build_players.py`, then re-verified on Nov 05 2026 (see the re-run
106: entry above). No other product or test failures were open after that
107: pass.
108: 
109: Test bugs found and fixed in this pass (all in the tester's own new
110: tests, not product issues): (1) an anti aligned trough delta assertion
111: used a wrong hand computation, the synthetic ledger's monotone path keeps
112: the trough at the conserved final balance, so the assertion now checks
113: that monthly closes move instead; (2) two empty mask assertions compared
114: against the modified series instead of the original input; (3) one
115: findings parser expectation added a `findings.` prefix the
116: `numbersOf` guard never emits. After those fixes every pre existing
117: test and every other new test passes.
118: 
119: No product bugs were found in the reducer, orbit math, resolveRows, or
120: the findings parser. Every documented boundary behaved as specified:
121: loss precedence over yearComplete on the closing month, auto demo exit
122: on rejected manual input, strict greater than threshold in F1, and
123: verification failure without throwing on a corrupted checksum.
124: 
125: ### Coverage summary
126: 
127: - Vitest: 106 tests, 13 files, all pass. Happy path, edge cases, and
128:   error conditions covered for the pure game core, orbit closed forms,
129:   data loaders, checksums, resolveRows, findings parser, and the
130:   findings view stopgap.
131: - Pytest: 41 tests, all pass (39 of 40 at the time of the original run,
132:   with the one zero byte CSV product bug since fixed). F1 to F5
133:   artifact equality, verification checks, builder validation guards
134:   (NaN, inf, range, containment, size, and empty or missing column
135:   CSV shapes including zero byte files for both builders), and
136:   unit level classifier and counterfactual boundaries.
137: - Not covered anywhere: real browser interaction, renderer (still the
138:   pending scene summary), performance budget, and the GitHub Pages
139:   deploy workflow.
140: 
141: ### Gaps the Saturday hackathon window should still test
142: 
143: - Browser level end to end: PLAY button click through, 45 second idle
144:   auto demo start, keyboard Tab and Space input adapters, pointer
145:   selection, and the Inspector click to expand provenance rows. No
146:   headless browser exists in this environment; install Playwright or
147:   drive a real browser at the booth rehearsal.
148: - Renderer once Tier T1 lands: WebGL2 frame output, the 2D CRT
149:   phosphor fallback, 60 fps budget, dpr cap 1.5, and label culling near
150:   20 entities.
151: - F3 beyond artifact equality: model card rendering, AUC drift when the
152:   mock ledger is regenerated with a different seed, and the disclosed
153:   split rule behavior.
154: - Full report UI when it is approved: chart twins, honesty badges, and
155:   explore in game deep link, plus sharing the F4 counterfactual module
156:   between report and game as promised in docs/decisions.md.
157: - CI and deploy: run the web and python jobs in .github/workflows/ci.yml
158:   on a clean clone, and verify the Pages deploy with base path aware
159:   assets.
160: - Data regeneration flow: change the mock generator seed, rerun
161:   build_world, build_findings, verify_findings, and confirm the report
162:   regenerates with derived narrative sentences.

Last updated: Nov 07 2026

## Nov 07 2026 - Mock data removal: obsolete test cleanup

The `data/mock/` folder was deleted as part of the Financial Resilience
Engine pivot, so two test cases that read the deleted CSVs failed. Only
those two cases were removed, plus helpers used exclusively by them. No
live functionality lost coverage and no assertion was weakened.

### Test cases removed

| Test | Why it was mock only |

The file is deleted, so it failed with "input file not found". |
